{{Quote|There she is, the Aurora. Pretty impressive|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:TMK" />}}
The '''''Aurora''''' was a heavily modified [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] that was in the service of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] respectively.

==History==
{{Quote|Attention unidentified vessel, this is the Republic cruiser Aurora. You are in a restricted zone. Prepare to be brought aboard for a full inspection. If you offer any resistance, we will open fire.|Captain [[Ofaree]], to the [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft|Hunter's ''D5-Mantis'' Patrol Craft]]|<ref name="TOR:TMK" />}}
The ''Aurora'' was originally assigned to patrol the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. In one [[Battle between the Aurora and the Hook Talons|engagement]], the defeated twenty eight corvettes and frigates of the [[Hook Talons|Hook Talon pirates]], wiping them out.<ref name="TOR:codex" />

[[File:Aurora_%26_D5-Mantis.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Aurora'' captures the [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft|Hunter's ''D5-Mantis'' Patrol Craft]].]]
At the end of the Great Galactic War, the ship was given under the command of Jedi Master [[Kellian Jarro]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ofaree]] while serving as a deep space commando training center where elite [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special forces]] units practiced boarding action scenarios.<ref name="TOR:codex" />

That would come to an end during the Cold War, when [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tarro Blood]] was captured on board and admitted to an Imperial assassination attempt on the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Shortly after, the future [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]'s [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft |''D5-Mantis'' Patrol Craft]] arrived to kill the Jedi Master and Tarro Blood.<ref name="TOR:TMK" /> After dealing with Blood and Jarro, the hunter set the ships [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to activate on a timer. Having destroyed the ''Aurora's'' [[Hyperdrive regulator/Legends|hyperdrive regulator]] beforehand, the ship was ripped apart following its jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="TOR:TMK" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Auora.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Aurora'', as visible in the game]]
The ''Aurora'' is described as being a heavily-modified [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] in the Codex of the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="TOR:codex" /> but appears in-game as a ''Thranta''-class corvette.<ref name="TOR:TMK" /> According to [[Charles Boyd]], the ship was most likely intended to be a ''Valor''-class and the wrong model was used.<ref>{{Twitter|Charles_Boyd|status/1348739343276511233|[[Charles Boyd]]|quote=I'd guess the same thing as you, that it was intended as a Valor-class, not a Thranta. But I didn't write that one so I couldn't say the original intent definitively.|archivedate=20210111212553}}</ref>
